title: Geocentric
summary: GEOCEN'TRIC, adjective [Gr. earth, and center.] Having the earth for its center, or the same center with the earth. The word is applied to a planet or its orbit.

inlines.v: GEOCEN'TRIC, adjective [Gr. earth, and center.] Having the earth for its center, or the same center with the earth. The word is applied to a planet or its orbit.
